description: Smoke coverage for a pinned income instance. Every package named here is a synthetic fixture; no scenario references a real borrower package, and no expected borrower value appears anywhere in this file. Assertions are JSON pointers into the assertion document described by InstanceAssertionDocument: the stored analysis result with its findings payload inflated under /findings. A scenario checks that the answer is shaped correctly, cites its evidence, and does not invent what the parse did not contain — never that it contains a particular number. Two cases assert an absence, and an absence is only worth asserting when the fixture makes it reachable: fixture-unsupported-only contains nothing an income contract allows, so a release must refuse it before analysis, and fixture-paystub-unreadable is a compatible paystub with every field MISSING, so a release is asked the question and has nothing true to answer with. Note the coupling this set assumes: a release whose parsed-data contract sets missingFields to REJECT refuses the unreadable paystub rather than reporting on it, and would fail the fourth case for that reason. This set is for releases that tolerate missing fields and are expected to say so.
